parts.instruction: You will hear three different extracts. For questions 1-6, choose the answer (A, B or C) which fits best according to what you hear. There are two questions for each extract.

questions.prompt: How does the woman feel now about her first job in retailing?

options.label: pleased by the way she handled the staff
confident that it gave her a good start
relaxed about the mistakes she made

questions.prompt: What is the woman advised to do next?

options.label: reflect on her skills
volunteer for extra work
discuss her situation with her boss

questions.prompt: What problem did the woman have with the swan?

options.label: She misunderstood its intentions
She underestimated the speed of its approach
She failed to realise the consequences of disturbing it

questions.prompt: What is the man’s reaction to the story?

options.label: He feels he would have handled the situation better
He is unconvinced by the woman’s version of events
He fails to see quite how serious the problem was

questions.prompt: Why did Bruce decide to give up the idea of studying art?

options.label: He failed to gain a place at art college
He became tired of doing representational art
He was persuaded that he could not realise his ambition

questions.prompt: What was his father’s reaction to Bruce’s decision?

options.label: He was anxious to discuss alternative employment options
He was angry that a good opportunity had been wasted
He was dismissive of the advantages of higher education HINTS AND KEYWORDS

parts.instruction: You will hear an explorer called Richard Livingstone talking about a trip he made in the rainforest of South America. For questions 7-14, complete the sentences.

questions.prompt: Richard and Matthew abandoned their boat because they couldn’t get past a ________ .
They decided to walk through the jungle as far as the ________ marked on the map.
Richard says that during the walk, they were always both ________ .
The first sign of human activity that they found was a ________ .
In a deserted camp, they found some soup made from unusual ________ .
Richard says that by the time they had reached the camp, they were lacking in ________ .
Richard says that after the meal, they began to feel ________ about what they’d done.
Before leaving the camp, they left the sum of ________ to thank their host.

parts.instruction: You will hear part of an interview with the astronaut Charles Duke, who is talking about his trip to the moon. For questions 15-20, choose the answer (A, B, C or D) which fits best according to what you hear.

questions.prompt: How did Charles feel about space travel as a boy?

options.label: He thought it was unlikely to happen
He regarded it as more than science fiction
He was fascinated by the idea of it
He showed no particular interest in it

questions.prompt: What did Charles consider to be the hardest part of the training?

options.label: feeling trapped in the heavy spacesuit
endlessly practising the lunar surface landing
constantly being afraid of making a mistake
being unable to move his arms and hands

questions.prompt: What was Charles’s reaction when he first found out he was going to the moon?

options.label: He realised he had to be cautious
He felt proud to be given the opportunity
He tried to control his excitement
He reflected on his chances of survival.

questions.prompt: How did the crew feel when they had landed on the moon?

options.label: They felt as if they were coming home
They realised they had achieved something special
They were afraid of what they might find on the surface
They were worried about how they would take off again

questions.prompt: What feature of the moon made the greatest impact on Charles?

options.label: the brightness of the
the vastness of the sky
the loneliness of the place
the absence of any stars

questions.prompt: What does Charles feel was the most memorable part of his mission?

options.label: nearly falling into a crater
walking on the moon’s surface
seeing things never seen before
holding a piece of the moon HINTS AND KEYWORDS
